conditions: Isolate from current GitHub main. Do not copy an uncommitted Speaker tree and do not edit Speaker sources.
Publish all ten spirits or nothing. A missing required provider rejects the whole archetype.
Use Wizard level, Intelligence and Charisma only on the branches named in C-frozen-contract.md.
Run these cases through native resource, restriction and parameter components. A component field being present is not a pass.

cases.setup: Wizard 8 Spirit Whisperer, Charisma 14, full Enemies' Bane pool (5).
cases.action: Execute Enemies' Bane once through AbilityCastRateUtils.SpendResources and its effect.
cases.expect: Pool is 4. The one-minute weapon effect is applied once.
cases.negative: A second resource component on the parent or weapon enchantment must not move the pool to 3.

cases.setup: Same character with the pool spent to 0.
cases.action: Ask IsAbilityRestrictionPassed, then do not run the effect.
cases.expect: Restriction is false, pool stays 0, no bane effect is present.
cases.negative: Calling the effect after a failed restriction is not a legal cast and must not be recorded as success.

cases.setup: Pool at 5. Caster restriction fails, or the cast is cancelled before SpendResources.
cases.expect: Pool stays 5 and no cooldown or effect buff is applied.
cases.negative: A failed save after a legal cast does not refund the point.

cases.setup: Wizard 8, Shard Soul pool at 3, no cooldown buff.
cases.action: Execute once, then attempt again while the 1d4-round cooldown fact remains.
cases.expect: First cast leaves the pool at 2 and applies the private cooldown to the caster. Second attempt fails AbilityCasterHasNoFacts, leaves the pool at 2, and does not refresh the cooldown.
cases.negative: Changing Intelligence or Charisma does not change the maximum of 3. Rest removes the cooldown buff and refills the pool to 3 without refilling a foreign resource.

cases.setup: Charisma 10, Battle Spirit pool at 3. No AbilityResourceLogic on the toggle.
cases.action: Activate with a standard command and invoke ActivatableAbilityResourceLogic.OnNewRound once. Then deactivate.
cases.expect: Exactly one point is spent by the new-round callback. Deactivate does not refund it. Combat-end deactivation does not spend an extra point.
cases.negative: At 0 the toggle is unavailable and cannot remain on. A parallel AbilityResourceLogic must not spend a second point.

cases.branch: Life channel shared pool and Charisma DC
cases.setup: Wizard 8, Charisma 14 so the shared channel pool is 3. Intelligence 10.
cases.action: Spend the heal leaf once. Calculate harm-leaf DC.
cases.expect: Both leaves use one resource. After heal, harm sees 2 remaining. Channel DC is 18. The variant parent has no AbilityResourceLogic.
cases.negative: Raising Intelligence does not change this DC or this pool. A cleric or native Extra Channel resource is unchanged. Extra Channel (Spirit Whisperer Life Spirit) adds 2 only to this pool.

cases.action: Apply one link, then remove that buff through its own end action.
cases.expect: The link spends one point, then ending it restores exactly one point.
cases.negative: Ending it does not restore two points or raise the pool above 5. A sixth simultaneous link is impossible.

cases.setup: Wizard 8. Start at Intelligence 18, Charisma 10. Then set Intelligence 10 and Charisma 18.
cases.action: Read Shard Soul DC, Enemies' Bane maximum, Life Channel DC, and Heavens Manifestation save bonus.
cases.expect: First state: Shard Soul DC 18, Bane maximum 3, Channel DC 14, Heavens saves +4. Second state: Shard Soul DC 14, Bane maximum 7, Channel DC 18, Heavens saves +0.
cases.negative: No branch uses Wisdom. Benefit of Wisdom changes Lore (Nature/Religion) to Intelligence and does not rewrite Knowledge (Arcana/World).

cases.setup: Wizard 1 / Fighter 19 with the archetype, and a separate Shaman 20 without it.
cases.action: Evaluate progression entries, a class-ranked damage value, and Shaman blueprint identity.
cases.expect: The whisperer has only the level-1 ability. Dice and DC use Wizard level 1. Shaman archetype count and a sampled native spirit component array are unchanged.
cases.negative: Fighter or Shaman levels do not unlock level 8 or 20 and do not enter m_Class.

cases.setup: Battle progression selected. Hex selection at level 5.
cases.action: Evaluate CanSelect for a Battle hex, a Flame hex, and WizardFeatSelection.
cases.expect: Battle hex and the wizard bonus feat are selectable. Flame hex is not. IgnorePrerequisites is false.
cases.negative: Level 20 does not contain a fourth hex selection. The same hex cannot be taken at both level 5 and 10. Waves does not offer Fluid Magic and does offer Beckoning Chill.

cases.action: Inspect the bond selection and the removed native selections.
cases.expect: Specialist school and the original arcane bond are removed. The new selection's own components are empty, its choices come from 363cab72f77c47745bf3a8807074d183, and it contains no bonded item.
cases.negative: The native familiar selection and BloodlineFamiliar01446 are not rewritten. A wizard 5 / rogue 0 familiar does not scale from rogue level.

cases.setup: Published Lore and Life progressions at the levels being tested.
cases.expect: Lore level 8 is Perfect Knowledge (+10 competence on the four knowledge/lore skills), not Arcane Enlightenment. Lore level 20 includes one fixed Wish use with Intelligence parameters. Life level 8 is Healer's Touch. Life has no Quick Healing feature.
cases.negative: Heavens level 20 has no Extend/Reach toggle. Flame, Stone, Waves and Wind level 20 do, and those toggles do not raise spell level.

cases.setup: Flame manifestation. One fire spell and one non-fire spell prepared.
cases.expect: Extend turns off when Reach turns on. The fire spell gains that metamagic with no spell-level or cast-time increase. The non-fire spell does not.
cases.negative: No resource is spent. A spell tagged only with an absent Air/Water/Earth flag is outside the filter. AutoMetamagic.ShouldApplyTo is not globally patched.

cases.setup: Character has a whisperer Stardust effect and a foreign buff with the same display name but a different source blueprint.
cases.action: Remove the whisperer progression feature, including retraining that fact away.
cases.expect: Only facts and resources whose source GUID is in the 0117 set are removed. The ability no longer passes its caster restriction.
cases.negative: The foreign buff and any native shaman or cleric resource remain. Removal does not push a resource pool negative.

cases.setup: R1 pool partially spent. Charisma then rises by 4, later falls by 4. A rest occurs with a cooldown buff up.
cases.action: Apply the stat changes and a native rest.
cases.expect: The maximum follows Charisma. An increase adds the new uses. A decrease clamps the current amount to the new maximum. Rest refills this pool to maximum and removes the cooldown.
cases.negative: Rest does not refill an unrelated foreign pool, because this package does not patch global rest.

cases.setup: Cache missing one required donor GUID from contract section 9.
cases.expect: Register returns false, writes no private blueprint, and does not append a Wizard archetype, UI group or feat.
cases.negative: A later call after the donor appears may publish the complete archetype once. A second successful call does not append a duplicate archetype.
